Final categorization: OK  
(Justification: The paper presents original research focused on simulating future land use/land cover (LULC) change at the national scale of China. It explicitly implements two contrasting future scenarios (Scenario A: increasing grain yield; Scenario B: constant yield) and quantitatively compares projected land use areas and spatial patterns across 2020, 2050, and 2080. The modeling framework integrates socioeconomic drivers, ecosystem processes, and a spatial land allocation model (based on CLUE principles) to produce mapped LULC projections at 10 km resolution. Quantitative results include land area changes (%), conversion matrices, and spatially explicit maps showing hotspots of change. The primary objective is LULC prediction under alternative scenarios, meeting all core inclusion criteria: national-scale spatial implementation, primary focus on LULC simulation, ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison, spatial modeling with reported accuracy/validation (e.g., Figure 3 validation against 2010 data), and mapped outputs. It does not meet any exclusion criteria.)
